caption: One case from the record UNITARES keeps of its own development. The timeline and session pointer came from UNITARES; the task itself was recovered from the local transcript and Git history.

entries.text: The agent was partway through an audit, with three pull requests open and more work unfinished in its worktrees.
Its session ended before it could write a handoff.

The successor declared that it continued the interrupted agent, then followed the recorded timeline and session pointer to the audit's last work and its three open pull requests. All three merged that day.
